facilityStatePolicy.decision: Normalize facilities through explicit import actions, not by deleting caveats.
runtimeMapping: Only import, import-as-access, import-as-rule-warning and attach-to-parent records may become runtime data.
Pending-review and suppress records remain in research/candidate artifacts and must not appear as normal user-facing facilities.
Side-trip metadata can become user-facing only if the route or POI is intentionally modeled as a side trip.
facilityStatePolicy.parentClusterPolicy: Cluster first, then split typed subfacilities only where coordinates, confidence and app taxonomy justify separate markers.
facilityStatePolicy.parkingAndTransitPolicy: Parking and transit should be treated consistently with existing app trails: import verified, useful access records as user-facing parking/transit facilities or accessPoints, dedupe them by cluster, and keep timetable/parking-rule details caveated and live-checkable.
facilityStatePolicy.informalTentingPolicy: Informal tenting remains a separate candidate category. Promote to runtime camping only when rules and coordinates support it; otherwise keep as caveated rule/access text or pending-review.
facilityStatePolicy.privateCommercialPolicy: Private, customer-only, seasonal or opening-hours-dependent services can be imported only with clear caveats and publication-time recheck requirements.
